summary: Ashfox is the open-source Assets as Code toolkit for voxel games. Define models, textures, and sounds in code. Version them in Git. Build them with Ashfox.
pageTitle: Assets as Code for voxel games
instruction: Read https://ashfox.io/agent.md in full, follow its installation and task-specific documentation guidance, and set up Ashfox in this project. Then create and verify the assets I request. If I have not described an asset yet, ask what I want to make after setup.
